speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: Tracking residual stock and margin is just the floor, not the ceiling for the promotion week. I need the KPIs to automatically flag when the margin target is missed so we can adjust the allocation before the pallets are even loaded.
output.correction: I am not asking for a dashboard that simply displays the numbers after the fact. I need the system to calculate the impact in real time so we can see the operational cost of a missed forecast while we still have the chance to act on it.
